start: Verify the exact four repository commits and trees are clean and the four loopback ports 55432, 58442, 58443 and 58444 are absent.
Verify six disjoint empty current-UID mode-0700 capability roots, the mode-0600 public allowed-signers file, pinned Python and patched B1 wheel outside all repositories.

Use a clean detached Suite worktree at commit 8e6f05f823b237b8c1b93e630182d570062b239e, change directory to integration/compose/integrated-uat, generate the canonical no-trailing-newline unsigned payload with scripts/generate_master_authorization.py emit and obtain the external Founder SSHSIG under namespace cybrik-uat-soc-ai-fabric-v1.

From that exact integration/compose/integrated-uat directory, set CYBRIK_UAT_AUTHORIZATION_FILE and CYBRIK_UAT_AUTHORIZATION_SIGNATURE to the exact artifacts and invoke python -B -P scripts/run_integrated_uat.py --execute once.
stop: Run the integrated common teardown for every entered child stage, then verify all four listeners, PostgreSQL, child processes, containers and ephemeral PKI are absent.
Preserve the immutable terminal seal and evidence; unset all CYBRIK_UAT variables after absence is proven.
reset: Before execution require all six capability roots to be empty; no existing runtime, evidence or state is reusable.
After terminal teardown, reset means proving the same roots contain only the immutable authorized evidence artifacts and no live runtime resource.
seed: Permit only the child stages' tracked synthetic fixtures for tenant, organization, actor, alert, investigation, delegation and receipt data.
Reject customer data, production logs, production configuration, production credentials and any untracked seed source.
rollback: On every exception, run idempotent child teardown followed by common teardown and exact absence proof.
A post-consumption failure is terminal: preserve evidence and do not retry, replace the seal or reuse the authorization.
